import sys
import heapq

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        print(-1)
        return
    
    n = int(data[0])
    
    if n == 0:
        print(-1)
        return
    
    if len(data) < n + 1:
        print(-1)
        return
    
    files = list(map(int, data[1:n+1]))
    
    if len(files) != n:
        print(-1)
        return
    
    if n == 1:
        print(0)
        return
    
    for size in files:
        if size <= 0:
            print(-1)
            return
    
    heapq.heapify(files)
    
    total_cost = 0
    
    while len(files) > 1:
        a = heapq.heappop(files)
        b = heapq.heappop(files)
        cost = a + b
        total_cost += cost
        heapq.heappush(files, cost)
    
    print(total_cost)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
